class.name: OcgBopalgoOptions
class.brief_description: The class provides the following options for the algorithms in Boolean Component: - *Memory allocation tool* - tool for memory allocations; - *Error and warning reporting* - allows recording warnings and errors occurred during the operation. Error means that the algorithm has failed. - *Parallel processing mode* - provides the possibility to perform operation in parallel mode; - *Fuzzy tolerance* - additional tolerance for the operation to detect touching or coinciding cases; - *Using the Oriented Bounding Boxes* - Allows using the Oriented Bounding Boxes of the shapes for filtering the intersections.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears all warnings and errors, and any data cached by the algorithm. User defined options are not cleared.

method.name: AddError
method.description: Adds the alert as error (fail)

method.name: AddWarning
method.description: Adds the alert as warning

method.name: HasErrors
method.description: Returns true if algorithm has failed

method.name: HasError
method.description: Returns true if algorithm has generated error of specified type

method.description: Returns true if algorithm has generated some warning alerts

method.name: HasWarning

method.name: GetReport
method.description: Returns report collecting all errors and warnings

method.name: DumpWarnings
method.description: Dumps the warning statuses into the given stream
